answer: Each challenge is derived from a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable until publication. Participants commit before the pulse, then reveal a response bound to that pulse and their registered identity. This trellis of freshness makes cached answers useless; the whisper of an unknown challenge denies automated sybil swarms an offline target to farm, while a new pulse arrives like a gale beyond any operator’s control.
